description: An input with no recoverable intent; every reading is defensible and none is confident.
notes: Three words with no verb, no date, and no resolvable subject. sprockets/note is the doctrine reading - reference or idea, no action - but task and entity are both defensible, so they are permitted rather than asserted. What is NOT permitted is a cogs/daily: putting this on a day invents a commitment the user never made, and that is the failure being graded. The confidence assertion is the point: a confident answer here is wrong regardless of which type it picks, because nothing in the input supports confidence. Contrast with empty-greeting, where the correct output is nothing at all; here there is something worth keeping and the only honest way to keep it is flagged.
